artist.name: AVANTIKA
artist.bio: Avantika is an Indian-born DJ, producer and singer who plays house music with live vocals, drawing on classical Indian vocal training and rock. Her debut EP, Moody Koyal, came out on Berlin label Get Physical Music in June 2025. Press around the release called her the first Indian DJ to play EXIT Festival in Serbia.

eras.sound: Indian vocals and traditional influences over club house
eras.source_name: The Everyday Agency (press release for Get Physical)
